describes: A test record for design.md 7b (changed by data alone): a walling table in the pack's shape (packs/stavanger-1989/walling.json) with two workings no wall in the gully has, a mortared granite wall of the 1930s and its 1961 cement rebuild. tools/r1_elevations.py merges them into a copy of the pack's table, sets the gully's facts to name them (`applies`), and lays and checks the same walls with the same functions and no code edit. Its numbers are a plausible coursed granite's, for the check alone; they are not researched and enter no pack.

notes.mortared-granite-1930: Squared granite in level courses, bedded in mortar: deeper courses than the split slate (every rise of the gully one course), longer stones (300 to 1200 mm, drawn 2 to 4 times their height), thicker and longer slab copes, through stones about every 1.4 m (a mortared wall needs fewer ties than a dry one). Values chosen for the check, not from a source.
notes.cement-relaid-granite-1961: The facts' 1961 rebuild of fl-0/r, had the wall been granite: its own stones relaid in cement, its edges long and short in alternate courses, the short no shorter than the working's least stone.
